category_title: High-level readers receiving advanced cognitive challenges
student_description: This student is a high-level reader who easily grasps basic plot points and factual information. They thrive when pushed to provide complex, multi-sentence responses involving character analysis and thematic interpretation. They uniquely require a high density of advanced cognitive challenges—specifically inference, justification, and opinion questions—rather than standard comprehension checks.

criteria.rationale: This high-level reader easily answers basic factual questions and requires advanced cognitive challenges to deepen their comprehension.
criteria.check: The tutor's response must include at least one question that prompts the student to make an inference, justify a claim, or express an opinion.

criteria.rationale: Asking multiple follow-up questions within the same exchange pushes the student to provide the complex, multi-sentence thematic interpretations they are capable of.
criteria.check: The tutor must prompt the student to expand on a previous statement, explain a story element they just mentioned, or build on a prior response within the ongoing exchange.

criteria.rationale: Closed-ended questions about basic story elements require minimal inferential comprehension and fail to engage this advanced reader.
criteria.check: The tutor must NOT limit their inquiry to closed-ended questions about characters, setting, or plot that only require basic factual recall.
